name: Valles de Benavente

known.via: English Wikipedia "Valles de Benavente" (a wine place on Wikidata)

terms: Vino de Calidad con Indicación Geográfica, a Spanish tier above Vino de la Tierra and below DO.
Young wine, sold with little or no aging. Some see a few months in oak.

blurb.text: A Vino de Calidad in northeastern Zamora province, Castile and León, a Spanish tier above Vino de la Tierra and below DO. Its rules allow red Tempranillo, Prieto Picudo, Mencía, Garnacha Tinta and Cabernet Sauvignon, and white Verdejo and Doña Blanca.
